summary: Iteration 2 — Full auth flow testing (Emergent Google Auth). Backend: all 7 auth endpoint tests pass. Frontend: ProtectedRoute, Login button → auth.emergentagent.com redirect, session cookie login, user menu, logout flow all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS allow_origins splits on ',' but doesn't strip whitespace — fine for single origin currently, but could silently fail with 'a, b' format. Minor.
exchange_session upserts user by email but logs 'last_login' as ISO string while created_at is also ISO string — consistent, OK.
No pagination/cleanup of expired user_sessions documents — consider periodic sweep or TTL index.
test_credentials: Seeded MongoDB directly (and cleaned up): user_id=test-user-fixed, email=test.user@example.com, valid_token=test_session_fixed_token_abc123, expired_token=test_session_expired_token_xyz789. Playbook: /app/auth_testing.md
seed_data_creation: Seeded two user_sessions (valid + expired) and one users doc in mongosh test_database; cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is working end-to-end. Backend tests under /app/backend/tests/test_auth.py are idempotent (they seed their own logout token). Finance CRUD flows were validated in iteration_1 — not retested. If re-running test_auth.py, first seed valid/expired users via /app/auth_testing.md Step 1 using the exact tokens in the test file, or adapt the fixture. CORS_ORIGINS in /app/backend/.env matches the preview URL and allow_credentials=true, cookie samesite=none secure=true — all verified working.
